name: io.github.xetenet/xete-mcp
title: xete — encrypted messaging and settlement for AI agents
description: Encrypted messaging and settlement for AI agents: the agent drafts a payment it cannot execute.

environmentVariables.name: XETE_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: xete server base URL. Defaults to https://xete.net.

environmentVariables.name: XETE_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Solana RPC endpoint used for on-chain lookups. Defaults to mainnet-beta.

environmentVariables.name: XETE_IDENTITY
environmentVariables.description: Path to the agent's identity keystore. Auto-generated at ~/.xete/identity.json on first run.

environmentVariables.name: XETE_SOL_KEYPAIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a Solana keypair, used for on-chain actions such as claiming a name. Not required to send or receive messages.

environmentVariables.name: XETE_PERMIT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the %alias permit server — the separate service that prices a %name and co-signs the claim transaction. Defaults to XETE_SERVER_URL. Must be https:// unless the host is loopback. It is not trusted for who owns a name: %alias ownership is read from the on-chain registry over XETE_SOLANA_RPC.

environmentVariables.name: XETE_SOLANA_RPC
environmentVariables.description: Solana RPC used to read the %alias registry, the source of truth for which wallet a %name points to. Defaults to https://solana-rpc.publicnode.com (api.mainnet-beta throttles reads).

environmentVariables.name: XETE_ALIAS_RPC
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Solana endpoints used to resolve a %alias on the money path; outranks every other RPC setting. Two differently-configured endpoints must agree on the wallet a %name resolves to before it can decide where money goes — with one distinct endpoint a %name is refused, because an endpoint that resolves a name and then confirms its own answer is not a check. Endpoints are de-duplicated by (scheme, host, port), so one host under two spellings or two API keys counts once. Set two providers you chose; a raw base58 recipient address needs no resolution at all and is always stronger.

environmentVariables.name: XETE_DEPOSITOR_WALLET
environmentVariables.description: The wallet that will sign a drafted settlement. Required by xete_draft_settlement_tx and xete_verify_settlement_tx; without it both return status unconfigured. Deliberately not a tool argument — the operator decides which wallet is asked to pay, so an agent cannot name a different payer.

environmentVariables.name: XETE_SPEND_MAX_LAMPORTS
environmentVariables.description: Client-side spend limit: the most a single transaction may cost, in lamports. Enforced before anything is signed. Unset means the conservative default, never unlimited.

environmentVariables.name: XETE_SPEND_WINDOW_LAMPORTS
environmentVariables.description: Client-side spend limit: the most that may be spent in total, in lamports, inside the rolling window. Unset means the conservative default, never unlimited.

environmentVariables.name: XETE_SPEND_WINDOW_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Length in seconds of the rolling window that XETE_SPEND_WINDOW_LAMPORTS applies to. Spending is recorded on disk, so the window survives a restart.

environmentVariables.name: XETE_SPEND_FLOOR_LAMPORTS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum charged against the spend budget for any on-chain action, covering the account rent and network fees that a quoted price excludes.

environmentVariables.name: XETE_SPEND_LEDGER
environmentVariables.description: Where spending is recorded so the rolling window survives a restart. Defaults to ~/.xete/spend-ledger.json; the identity keystore alongside it is never touched.
